record.body: This index lists the sources and design principles behind the Signature animal-vocal-communication edition, so that every claim in the edition can be traced. The edition's models draw on the real literature named in the public edition's sources index, Seyfarth and Cheney, Payne and McVay, Poole and Payne, Slobodchikoff, Janik, and the songbird learning literature, as structural models only. Every pitch, duration, and rate in the Signature edition is an original design choice, stated as such, and no Signature figure is presented as a measurement from any real animal. Figures are given as of October 2026. This record is about Signature designs, which are inventions, and it claims nothing about real animals beyond the models it names.
